packs.name: Gravity Suit, Beams and HD Interface
packs.title: Metroid Prime 2: Echoes
packs.author: MegaManZX2245
packs.notes: Gravity Suit colours, Metroid Prime 1 beam textures and HD interface textures for Prime 2. The zip holds one G2ME01 folder of PNGs.

packs.name: HD Texture Pack v2.5
packs.title: Paper Mario: The Thousand-Year Door
packs.author: Invader
packs.notes: Download from the thread: DDS pack recommended, PNG legacy pack also there. Size and archive type not stated.

packs.name: HD Textures (Thorn)
packs.title: Fire Emblem: Path of Radiance
packs.author: Thorn
packs.notes: Upscaled textures for the US disc. The author advises 4:3, as backgrounds and portraits stretch at 16:9. Forum settings: 3x internal, 2x MSAA, no texture filtering.

packs.name: F-Zero GX HD (DDS-BC7)
packs.title: F-Zero GX
packs.author: Venomalia
packs.notes: DDS-BC7 textures. Download is on MEGA. The author says modified copies may be shared.

packs.name: UHD Textures (City Trial)
packs.title: Kirby Air Ride
packs.author: quinton-ashley
packs.notes: Retextures for the City Trial city area, about 8x original size, per the README. Parts are credited to Dolphin Forum members there. Files are DDS.

packs.name: HD Texture Pack (2020)
packs.title: Luigi's Mansion
packs.author: Your Pal Fox
packs.notes: 5x upscale with hand edits. Latest download in the thread is dated 11/8/20. Format and size not stated.

packs.name: UHD Texture Pack
packs.title: Super Mario Sunshine
packs.author: qashto and razius
packs.notes: Upscales and retextures for the whole game. The README says to use the DDS BC7 version. Turn on Load Custom Textures in the Advanced graphics settings.

packs.name: MP7 HD Textures
packs.title: Mario Party 7
packs.author: Najatski
packs.notes: AI-upscaled 4x textures, partly done (the README lists Grand Canal and Pagoda Peak as finished). The author calls the project dormant. Put the GP7E folder in Dolphin's Load/Textures folder.

packs.name: 4K Texture Pack
packs.title: Pikmin 2
packs.author: Henriko Magnifico
packs.notes: Standard and post-processing editions. Only NTSC textures are modified. Works with other mods that do not change the same textures.

packs.name: HD Texture Pack (DDS)
packs.title: Star Fox Adventures
packs.author: CYB3RTR0N
packs.notes: DDS textures on MEGA. The thread mentions an optional beta pack. Credits Krystal Archive, StarFox.org and razius.

packs.name: Definitive Edition+ 2.1
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
packs.author: Gossip Geist
packs.notes: HD DDS texture pack for the GameCube version. Four GameBanana parts: merge parts 2 to 4 into the main folder, then put it in the GZ2 texture folder.

packs.name: 720p DDS Pack
packs.title: The Legend of Zelda: Twilight Princess
packs.author: HenrikoMagnifico
packs.notes: Unofficial 720p DDS version of HenrikoMagnifico's texture pack, from the FHArchive release. Install as its README says; the folder has GZ2 and RZD marker files.

packs.name: Gravity Suit, PED Suit and HD Interface
packs.title: Metroid Prime 3: Corruption
packs.author: MegaManZX2245
packs.notes: Gravity Suit colours, a reversed 50% PED Suit and HD interface textures for Prime 3. The zip holds one RM3E01 folder of PNGs.

packs.name: MKWii Reloaded HD
packs.title: Mario Kart Wii
packs.author: GhostlyDark
packs.notes: HD texture pack for Mario Kart Wii, DDS, v0.2.0 release. Credits the Matteoki and Rmed24 HD pack. The author names no region.

packs.name: Mario Kart Wii HD Remaster (Forum)
packs.title: Mario Kart Wii
packs.author: Moukrea
packs.notes: Dolphin forum thread; the download is a Google Drive archive. Format and size not stated. The post says the pack is no longer in progress.

packs.name: Mario Kart Wii HD Remaster (GameBanana)
packs.title: Mario Kart Wii
packs.author: koolkreate
packs.notes: Two 7z downloads on GameBanana (main file 426 MB). Contents not opened here. Non-commercial, no derivatives licence.

packs.name: GLXY Repaint
packs.title: Super Mario Galaxy
packs.author: KramerRepaints
packs.notes: Full repaint with about 1800 textures, new dialogue and a new story. The File.Edits.zip download (audio and video) is not covered here.

packs.name: 4K Texture Pack
packs.title: Super Mario Galaxy 2
packs.author: iZePlayzYT
packs.notes: 4K textures made for Super Mario Galaxy 63; the README says they also work on the original game. Use the DDS folder in game. The PNG folder is for editing only.

packs.name: HD Textures v1.4
packs.title: Donkey Kong Country Returns
packs.author: CTCaer
packs.licence: Author allows reuse as a base for another pack with credit and a PM (forum post)
packs.notes: All-regions HD pack, v1.4. PNG (lossless) 7z is the one listed here; a DXT5 DDS 7z is also on the thread. Needs a 7-Zip with LZMA2 support.

packs.name: UHD Texture Pack
packs.title: The Last Story
packs.author: lunarEcho21
packs.notes: UHD textures on MEGA in two parts (4.0 GB and 2.86 GB) plus a 4.6 MB patch. The author says to unzip, and does not name the format.

packs.name: HD GUI+ Texture Pack
packs.title: The Last Story
packs.author: Matrix2525
packs.notes: Interface textures, as DDS (recommended by the author) or PNG, on MEGA. Version 1.0 from 2015. The author gives no further updates and asks for credit.

packs.name: HD Texture Pack (Beta 2)
packs.title: The Last Story
packs.author: themriron2
packs.notes: Beta 2 is DDS, from February 2020, on Google Drive. The wiki calls the pack abandoned. The first post's link is out of date.

packs.name: HD Texture Pack v2.81
packs.title: New Super Mario Bros. Wii
packs.author: Bighead
packs.notes: DDS (uncompressed) main pack, v2.81, from the forum thread linked by the Dolphin wiki. A PNG 7z is also on the thread. File size not stated.

packs.name: HD Texture Pack v8.52
packs.title: Xenoblade Chronicles
packs.author: Bighead
packs.notes: Version 8.52. Core textures are DDS, with Google Drive, MediaFire and MEGA mirrors. Needs Dolphin 5.0-6199 or newer. Archives are password protected; the password is on the thread.
